result:
PR #401 is now marked ready. The arm passed, and the magnitude check matched the offline prediction exactly.

**Why attempt 1 didn't finish:** it correctly stopped to wait for the arm. The arm sat behind the arms job's two-pairs-per-tick cap until 08:11 PDT. Both result directories were complete by the time this session resumed, but no `[job.arms]` verdict comment was ever posted to the PR. That is why the resume showed `arm=none`, so I judged the result directories directly. This is written up in `docs/lanes/flatlm13/NOTES.md`.

**Arm verdict** (flatlm13-orient.json; A 02374a6847 vs B 970c382ed1, Thor, 415 captures per arm):
- **`ab_compare --expect`: PASS.** All 417 registered checks hold: 6 better, 0 worse, 409 unchanged, and bit-exact captures stayed at 39. Only the six `Shade_model/ProgLM_{Quad,QuadStrip,Poly}_Flat_*` captures changed at all.
- **Size of the change:** wrong structural pixels fell from 610,437 to 607,673. The drop of 2,764 is exactly what the offline estimate predicted.
- **`price.py --verify`:** on all six captures, B is pixel-for-pixel what I predicted by recolouring A offline (0 px off). So reversing an edge doesn't change which pixels it covers.

| capture | wrong px, A → B |
|---|---|
| Quad_Flat ×2 | 1,408 → 994 |
| QuadStrip_Flat ×2 | 1,670 → 1,156 |
| Poly_Flat ×2 | 1,007 → 553 |

The judge labels the verdict "UNBOUND" only because the arms job queued these runs without `--expect` attached. The prediction was committed at 14:52 UTC, before either arm was queued at 15:11 UTC.

**Closing state:**
- NOTES and the PR body now carry the verdict. I posted a `[lane.flatlm13] verdict:` comment on the PR.
- The PR's `Files:` line matches the diff, the PR merges cleanly, and preflight passes.
- The new head, 49ecb3e0e7, is a notes-only change, so CI on it is still pending.
- The first preflight run this session reported FAILED, and its output was cut off before the failing check. A re-run passed, and I didn't identify the cause.

This hunk fixes 38% of class C. The rest needs a line input with a third slot in `glsl/geom.c`, which is another lane's file; NOTES describes the design.
